meta.name: BearChart
meta.subtitle: Build-A-Bear Price Guide
meta.disclaimer: BearChart is an independent collector/reseller research tool and is not affiliated with Build-A-Bear Workshop. Market values fluctuate.

retail_reference.warning: Current retail is a baseline only. It is never secondary-market value.
retail_reference.notes: Current Mini Beans retail sits around $10, licensed Mini Beans around $12.50, with bundles higher.

business.name: Jay's Retro Exchange
business.shop_headline: Buying and selling Build-A-Bear all week
business.shop_blurb: BearChart is built and run by Jay's Retro Exchange. Browse what is in stock, or send us a collection and we will make an offer on it.
business.shop_disclosure: We buy and sell the same items this guide values. No valuation on this site is adjusted because of it - the numbers come from recorded sold transactions, and you can see every one of them.
business.blurb: We buy Build-A-Bear collections. The range below is what we would pay, calculated from the same sold data shown on this page.
business.disclosure: Jay's Retro Exchange buys and sells Build-A-Bear items, and would be buying this one from you. Our offer is generated from the same public sold-comp data you can see above - we do not adjust a valuation because we want to buy it. You are free to sell elsewhere, and the guide will tell you the same number if you do.
business.affiliate_disclosure: Some links to eBay listings are affiliate links. They do not affect any valuation on this site, and they never influence which listings are shown.

free.name: Free
free.blurb: Everything the site itself can do. No account needed.
features: Condition-aware valuations with confidence and evidence
Collection tracking and checklists, stored in your browser
Deal finder over whatever listings are loaded

pro.name: Pro
pro.blurb: Your collection lives on the server instead of in one browser.
features: Collection and checklists synced across devices
Portfolio history kept server-side, surviving a cleared browser
Insurance schedule with the full evidence trail, archived and re-servable

power.name: Power
power.blurb: For sourcing. Alerts cost money to send and quota to find.
features: Deal alerts by push, Discord and email
Priority in the polling queue for the items you watch
Read API access to your own data

membership.hot_slot_note: Hot slots are shared. The most-watched items across all members get the 60-second queue; watching an item nobody else watches puts it in the 15-minute tier.
